Smoky pulled chicken under creamy coleslaw.How to make it600g chicken thigh fillets1 tsp smoked paprika4 tbsp smoky barbecue sauce1/4 white cabbage, finely shredded1/4 red cabbage, finely shredded1 carrot, grated4 tbsp whole-egg mayonnaise1 tbsp cider vinegar8 soft slider rollsRub the chicken with paprika and salt and pan-fry until cooked through.Shred with two forks and toss with the barbecue sauce.Toss both cabbages and the carrot with the mayo and vinegar.Fill the rolls with chicken and a big pile of slaw.Not-Josie-Grossie mini corn dogsShe's not Josie Grossie anymore. Cornmeal-battered mini franks with mustard.How to make it12 cocktail frankfurts120g fine cornmeal100g plain flour1 tbsp caster sugar2 tsp baking powder1 egg200ml milk1 L vegetable oil, for frying4 tbsp American mustard12 wooden skewersWhisk the cornmeal, flour, sugar, baking powder and salt, then the egg and milk, to a thick batter.Pat the franks dry and push a skewer into each.Dip in the batter and fry at 180°C until deep golden.Drain and serve hot with mustard.Denominators' salted pretzelsAldys saves Josie a seat.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.Front pageSun-Times deep dish pizzaJosie goes undercover for the Sun-Times. Chicago deep dish with sausage and mozzarella.How to make it500g pizza dough2 tbsp olive oil300g Italian pork sausages, skins removed350g mozzarella, sliced400g tin crushed tomatoes2 garlic cloves, crushed1 tsp dried oregano40g parmesan, finely gratedSimmer the tomatoes with the garlic, oregano and salt until thick.Oil a deep 25cm cake tin and press the dough up the sides.Layer the mozzarella on the base, then pinches of sausage, then the sauce, and finish with parmesan.Bake at 220°C on the lowest shelf until the crust is golden and the filling bubbles.The Court bonfire barbecue ribsAldys sizes up the fire in a trash can. Sticky pork ribs with charred corn.How to make it1.5kg pork spare ribs2 tbsp brown sugar1 tbsp smoked paprika1 tsp garlic powder200ml smoky barbecue sauce2 tbsp honey4 corn cobs30g butterRub the ribs with the sugar, paprika, garlic powder and salt.Wrap in foil and bake at 150°C until tender.Mix the barbecue sauce with the honey, brush over the ribs and grill hot until sticky and charred.Char the corn on the grill, brush with butter and serve with the ribs.Sweet stuffWho-ate-my-entire-pie cherry pieJosie can't work out who ate her pie. Lattice cherry pie with vanilla ice cream.How to make it2 sheets of shortcrust pastry2 x 680g jars of pitted morello cherries, drained100g caster sugar2 tbsp cornflour1 lemon, zested1 egg, beaten500ml vanilla ice creamLine a pie dish with one sheet of pastry.Toss the cherries with the sugar, cornflour and lemon zest and pile in.Cut the second sheet into strips, weave a lattice over the top and brush with egg.Bake at 190°C until golden and bubbling, then rest.Serve warm with ice cream.Late extraProm queen pink lemonadeJosie throws away the prom crown. Raspberry pink lemonade with mint over ice.How to make it150g raspberries100g caster sugar100ml water4 lemons750ml soda water1 cup mint leaves2 cups ice cubesSimmer the raspberries, sugar and water until syrupy, then strain and cool.Squeeze the lemons into a jug with the syrup.Fill glasses with ice and mint, pour in the pink base and top with soda.Newsroom drip coffeeIt took Sam forever to get here.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
